packageRules.description: Automatically merge Node.js and npm apk updates: superseded pins vanish from the Alpine package index and break the image build, so merge as soon as tests pass
Group the pinned Node.js and npm apk versions into one PR (separate aports, but both pins ride the same Alpine branch)

Ship Alpine base image patch bumps in the same PR as the Node.js and npm apk pins: all 3.24.x images share the v3.24 package index, so a separate base bump fails to build until the pin PR catches up. Automerge so it never blocks the automerged pin updates
